page.overview:
Who is Aloysia Telfan?

(pronounced like "ah-LOY-see-uh TELL-fin") is an elf agent of the Consortium of the Vermilion Dream.

When encountered in Bazzoxan, Aloysia is gaunt and wearing scarlet robes. She is described as tall and pale, and illustrated with shoulder-length, light-colored hair that drapes over her left eye.

Aloysia is ambitious in her pursuit of knowledge and power. She is described by an agent of a rival organization as cold-blooded, and indeed, she is willing to kill to get what she wants. But she is not so cynical as to avoid being shocked when she is betrayed.

She has at least a superficial charm: she is polite and pleasant while she still thinks she can persuade people to cooperate. But she quickly reveals a haughty manner with those who turn down her offers. To those who achieve enough initial success in tasks for the Consortium to be offered membership, she says she hopes to see them rise through its ranks.
